data.name: label4.Text
data.value: Career opportunities for BSCpE graduates include roles such as software developer, hardware engineer, systems analyst, network administrator, and IT support specialist. They can also work as embedded systems engineers, quality assurance testers, and technical support engineers. Advanced positions include senior software engineer, project manager, IT manager, systems architect, cybersecurity analyst, data scientist, and chief technology officer (CTO). Graduates can also start their own tech companies or consulting firms, making use of their technical skills and innovative ideas.

data.name: label2.Text
data.value: The Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering (BSCpE) program aims to strengthen students’ critical and creative thinking in analyzing, designing, implementing, and developing computers, computer-based systems, and networks by integrating both the software and hardware components in modern computing systems and computer-controlled equipment to solve complex engineering problems in the Philippines, the ASEAN region, and the world. The unified approach along with the strategic combination of theoretical and practical courses delivered in conventional and digital modalities shall develop students as professional, ethical, innovative, independent, and resilient computer engineers equipped with 21st century skills with strong service orientation, effective communication, and organizational skills in solving complex technical problems and adapt effectively to a new and shifting technologies in a diverse global environment.
